name: stats_calculator
label: Statistics
subtitle: Publication-ready statistical testing, effect sizes, power and corrections
about: A standalone Statistics app for the SciTeX workspace: run any of 23 tests, get effect sizes, power and APA/Nature/LaTeX formatting, and control multiple comparisons. The heavy lifting is the scitex-stats common package; this app is a thin UI over it.
description: SciTeX Statistics is a browser-based stats calculator built on the scitex-stats package. Pick a design (groups, sample sizes, outcome type, paired/between), get a ranked test recommendation, run it, and read the unified result dict: statistic, p-value, effect size, power, and a publication-ready APA / Nature / LaTeX string. Post-hoc comparisons and multiple-comparison corrections (Bonferroni, Holm, Sidak, FDR) are first-class.
author: ywatanabe
capabilities: Run any of 23 statistical tests through one dispatcher
Effect sizes (Cohen's d, eta-squared, Cliff's delta, prob. of superiority, epsilon-squared)
Power analysis and required sample size
Post-hoc pairwise comparisons (Tukey HSD, Games-Howell, Dunnett)
APA / Nature / LaTeX formatting for publication
